items.title: Joe Bushkin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Sinatra was the boy singer, they had Connie Haines with the group and the Pied Pipers. And I was really delighted to be with the Dorsey band... I always had Sinatra sitting right by the piano to tap me on the shoulder... check that arrangement out.

ctx.x: When did you first start to compose? © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -12-

Oh I don’t know. Automatically playing the piano and improvising you’re composing to start with. There was a situation that you might get a kick out of. Sinatra was the boy singer, they had Connie Haines with the group and the Pied Pipers. And I was really delighted to be with the Dorsey band, because you’ve got a nine foot coffin in front of you, and in any other band you’re out there alone. It’s not like being one of the trumpet players with a cohort on either side of you. And for instance when we were playing…
